faq.q: Will I lose rankings when I redesign?
faq.a: A short dip while Google re-crawls is normal. A lasting drop means something went wrong in the migration - usually missing redirects or removed content.

faq.q: Should I keep my old URLs?
faq.a: If they rank and make sense, yes. Changing URLs for tidiness alone is rarely worth the risk. Change them when the structure is genuinely wrong.
With redirects done properly, most sites are back to baseline within four to six weeks. Without them, recovery can take months and may never fully happen.
